title: Secret
description: A secret variable in the inventory. Secrets are encrypted and their values are not stored in plaintext in the inventory. They can be used for sensitive information such as API keys, passwords, etc.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The provider of the secret. Only 'vault' is currently supported.

scope.title: Variable Scope
scope.description: The scope of the variable (e.g. global, app:app-name)
